{
  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Your medicines",
      "bullets": [
        {
          "id": "b1",
          "text": "Take Azithromycin 250 mg by mouth once each day for 3 more days. This is an antibiotic for bacterial infections.",
          "sources": [
            "p1:L8",
            "drug:azithromycin",
            "term:PO"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "b2",
          "text": "Take Acetaminophen 650 mg by mouth every 6 hours only when you need it for fever or pain. Do not take more than 3,000 mg in one day. This is a pain reliever and fever reducer.",
          "sources": [
            "p1:L9",
            "drug:acetaminophen",
            "term:PO",
            "term:q6h",
            "term:PRN"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "b3",
          "text": "Take Metformin ER 500 mg by mouth once each day with dinner. This is a diabetes medicine to help control blood sugar.",
          "sources": [
            "p1:L10",
            "drug:metformin",
            "term:PO"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "b4",
          "text": "Take Atorvastatin 10 mg by mouth every night at bedtime. This is a cholesterol medicine to lower heart attack and stroke risk.",
          "sources": [
            "p1:L11",
            "drug:atorvastatin",
            "term:PO",
            "term:QHS"
          ]
        },
        {
          "id": "b5",
          "text": "Take Aspirin 81 mg by mouth once each day. This is a low-dose medicine for heart protection.",
          "sources": [
            "p1:L12",
            "drug:aspirin",
            "term:PO"
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
